# To translate: copy this file to strings.txt, change the text after " = " on each line, keep
# {0}, {1} and so on where the values go, and put strings.txt in the game folder under
# Mods\ShroomAccess\. Lines you leave out are said in English. Generated by tools\Export-Strings.ps1.

title.greeting = Shroom Access loaded. Shroom and Gloom: the title drips in slimy green and frosty blue letters over a black, star-speckled splat. Below it, three doorways stand side by side: a round steel vault door chained shut, a wooden door wrapped in thorny vines, and a padlocked cave mouth. Control Left and Right switch buffers; the last one is Help.

help.ctrl_up = Control Up reads on, Control Down goes back
help.rows = Up and Down arrows move between rows: Status at the top, then Nearby or Enemies, then Your hand
help.along_row = Left and Right arrows move along a row. A low sound means the end of the row
help.enter = Enter chooses. On a card in your hand it picks the card, then Enter on a target plays it
help.no_target = A card with no target is played by pressing Enter twice
help.backspace = Backspace cancels or goes back. Escape opens the pause menu
help.walk = Hold W to walk forward and S to walk back. A second voice speaks while you walk
help.arrivals = While you walk, a sound marks each thing that comes into reach. They are listed when you stop at a camp, and after a fight
help.death = When you die, Space moves through the words on screen. A sealed pack of cards is opened with Enter
help.space = Space ends your turn. At a camp, Space rests for the night and refills your energy
help.food = A food card can be aimed at you or at something hungry: after the first Enter, Left and Right choose, and you are said as You
help.shop = In a shop, Enter on a card, then pay one food at a time: Enter on a food card, then Enter on the bowl
help.soup = At a soup pot, put food in with Enter on a food card, then Enter on the pot. The soup value rises and opens dearer soups. Up goes to the open soups
help.map = M opens and closes the map. With the map open, Control Up reads each area
help.deck = Tab opens your draw pile; Tab again shows the discard pile, and again closes it. Up from the cards reaches buttons for the full deck and the combat, explore and foresight decks
help.inspect = I inspects. O sorts your hand
help.buffers = Control Left and Right switch buffer: Item, Player, Surroundings, Messages, Help
help.item_buffer = The Item buffer describes what you are on, ending with what it looks like
help.player_buffer = The Player buffer has your health, energy, piles, statuses and foresights
help.messages_buffer = The Messages buffer repeats what was said, newest first
help.status_enter = On the Status row, Enter reads the game's own explanation of a status
help.incoming = In a fight the Status row has the total damage the enemies intend this turn
help.card_label = A card's name is followed by the label under its title when it has one: uses left, battery, evolve
help.voice_rate = Control Page Up and Control Page Down make the walking voice faster or slower
help.bug_mark = Control B marks the moment for a bug report
help.update = When the title screen says a new version is out, Control O opens its download page and Control N, pressed twice, installs it
help.keys = Every key can be changed in the preferences file; the README says how
